asset_set: Questionnaire Q23 option 2 — Developing cancer treatment trials

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: friendly career exploration for students — hopeful, never clinical or sad

riasec_accent.use: glowing flask liquid, lab coat cuff stripe

riasec_secondary.use: microscope base accent, small hope-ribbon icon

color.background: transparent — faint warm grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small calm smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — calm short-haired researcher distinguishes this figure from surrounding characters

pose.stance: full body, standing at a research bench
pose.action: holding a glowing flask up toward the light with one hand, other hand resting gently on a microscope
pose.facing: 3/4 toward the flask, gaze lifted toward the glow
pose.energy: hopeful, serious but warm, never sad

top.detail: dark charcoal collar, purple cuff stripe

subject.scene_narrative: A man in a lab coat stands at a research bench, holding a small flask of glowing indigo liquid up toward the light while his other hand rests gently on a microscope, a tiny abstract hope-ribbon icon resting nearby — the same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references, deliberately symbolic and uplifting rather than clinical.
subject.hero_prop: glass flask with softly glowing indigo liquid, warm light radiating outward
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, warm soft glow, two faint grey circles behind figure — no clinical wall or equipment clutter
subject.sensitive_handling: Treat as symbolic and uplifting only — the glowing flask represents hope and discovery, not disease. Single calm researcher figure, no hospital imagery, no sick patients, no clinical distress, no sad color palette. Keep warm light, calm posture, quiet optimism.

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, flask glow right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + glowing flask readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter I, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, hospital gown, sick patient, clinical distress, sad expression, IV drip, graphic medical imagery

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background.
